{{Quote|I need a Nolarian 6000 drill immediately.''"<br />"''Don't have one. There's a shortage. And the way the mining safety committee has been watching us, there will be for a good while.|Dr. Lundi and a machinery dealer|<ref name="TF" />}}
The '''mining safety committee''' was an organization that was responsible for a shortage of [[Nolarian 6000 drill]]s<ref name="TF" /> in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nolar]], [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Murk Lundi]] was unable to purchase one of these [[Drill/Legends|drills]] from a [[Unidentified machinery dealer|machinery dealer]], who said that the shortage would last for some [[Time/Legends|time]] due to the committee's close oversight.<ref name="TF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mining safety committee was mentioned in the [[2002]] young readers novel ''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]'', written by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="TF" />
